imageContext:
Image alt: A vibrant picture is shown of three figures on a dark green background inside a brown and white letter “a” on a blue square with white “x” marks and dots throughout. The figure on the left is bald except for a ring of curly brown hair around his head, has rosy cheeks and lips, wears a long blue and brown robe and is barefoot. He faces to the right where a warrior stands with an orange upside down triangle shield with white designs. He wears a dark blue helmet covering his entire face, a dark blue sleeveless shirt with his neck, arms, and legs covered with blue stockings with white dots all over. Behind the warrior stands a figure with short hair, rosy cheeks and lips, wearing a helmet with a strap under the chin. He wears short brown robes, is barefoot, and holds a shovel in front of him facing the warrior.

He wears short brown robes, is barefoot, and holds a shovel in front of him facing the warrior.
English caption: Figure 13.8 Medieval European Society. This illuminated initial letter from a thirteenth-century French manuscript shows the key members of the medieval European social order: a member of the clergy, a warrior, and a laborer (left to right). (credit: “Cleric-Knight-Workman/MS Sloane 2435, folio 85” by British Library/Wikimedia Commons, Public Domain)
